catalyst_rows.raw_text: Received positive CHMP opinion recommending approval of REDEMPLO (plozasiran) to reduce triglycerides in adults with familial chylomicronemia syndrome in Europe. The European Commission is expected to issue a decision on REDEMPLO's Marketing Authorization in the second quarter of 2026;

extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: Tier1 sharpens REDEMPLO EU MA decision Q2 2026; most other ARWR program updates in recent PRs are retrospective achievements (FDA approval Nov 2025, ARO-DIMER-PA P1/2a initiated, obesity interim data presented) rather than forward-looking dated catalysts.
